instruction: Enable a feature to show exactly 25 tabs in the tab bar regardless of window size.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because Chrome does not provide settings to control how many tabs are visible in the tab bar. Tab visibility and sizing is automatically managed by Chrome based on window size and available space, and cannot be manually configured to show a fixed number of tabs.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible - Chrome does not provide native settings to control the number of visible tabs in the tab bar
The infeasible() function exists in the metrics module and is the appropriate evaluator for tasks that cannot be completed due to fundamental application limitations
Metadata explanation accurately describes why this task cannot be completed
No verification logic is needed since the task itself is impossible to complete
